data.summary: infra/worktree/_create.py:128 discards the result of sync(wt, cfg): claiming an item whose worktree is gone but whose branch exists, with worktree.sync_before_start on, leaves an unfinished merge of base (1606 staged paths, MERGE_HEAD set, conflict in ddflow/api/lane_views.py) while claim answers tree.how=created, broke=[] and no warning. An agent editing there would commit a merge it never chose. Probe: ddflow claim DX-fleet-registry, then git status in the tree shows 'You have unmerged paths'. branchsync.sync aborts on any non-pin conflict; this path does not.

data.summary: update --globs on a claimed item is refused as 'queued behind sw-cedefaults' when the list re-states README.md, a [lease] shared glob the item already held: same list minus README.md was accepted, so the waiter queue check ignores shared_globs and held globs. The same refusal also hid the real blocker: the lease.waiting record's `on` named resume-pssnap holding changes.toml, but the message named only the queue entry and no path. The refused update also leaves a standing lease.waiting (visible in `ddflow lanes`) that the caller is not told about.
data.title: ddflow update refuses a shared glob the item already holds, and the refusal hides the real holder

data.body:
Fixes bug B-update-queue-ignores-shared-globs: update --globs on a claimed item is refused as 'queued behind sw-cedefaults' when the list re-states README.md, a [lease] shared glob the item already held: same list minus README.md was accepted, so the waiter queue check ignores shared_globs and held globs. The same refusal also hid the real blocker: the lease.waiting record's `on` named resume-pssnap holding changes.toml, but the message named only the queue entry and no path. The refused update also leaves a standing lease.waiting (visible in `ddflow lanes`) that the caller is not told about. Found on DX-fleet-registry.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-update-queue-ignores-shared-globs --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-update-queue-ignores-shared-globs --regression-test <test>` first).
